about: E2 (F1): test-strategy decides each layer in its own `surfaces` row, and each step-plan criterion says `confirm: executed` or `confirm: inspected` with a reason. Written against feat/shiploop-templates-6d625a (arm T, the text-only batch); a field T already states is not repeated.

edits.old:
Name each code surface's native unit harness; an
   absent one is prerequisite work for prepare, never N/A.
edits.new:
Name each code surface's native unit harness; an
   absent one is prerequisite work for prepare, never N/A. Write a `surfaces` table there, one row per layer the
   request touches (unit, component, service, rendered UI): `| layer | harness | state | how a check runs it |`,
   state `available`, `prerequisite` (who builds it, before which item) or `unverifiable` (why no tool can).
   Decide each row alone: a missing tool for one layer decides only that row.

edits.old:
say whether it must be exercised or inspection suffices, and name the
   R-<n> served.
edits.new:
end it with `confirm: executed` (a command runs the behaviour) or
   `confirm: inspected - <why no runner can execute it>`, and name the R-<n> served. A criterion on a
   `surfaces` row whose state is `available` or `prerequisite` is `executed`.
